notes.title: Kimono Cats is coming in Q3 2025 - stay tuned!
notes.content:
[h2]Kimono Cats is coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch in Q3 2025![/h2]

Hey cozy game lovers! We’ve got some exciting news - Kimono Cats, the adorable feline festival adventure, is making its way to Steam and Nintendo Switch in Q3 2025!

RedDeer.Games, together with developer HumaNature Studios are working hand-in-hand to bring the game to both platforms ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/ef991c1aab63d81cb41ea695bcf17880a66182e2.jpg[/img]

Originally a fan-favorite on Apple Arcade, Kimono Cats is a hand-drawn, heartwarming game where you (and a friend, if you’re playing in co-op!) explore a colorful Matsuri festival as a cute cat in a kimono. Toss lucky coins, play charming mini-games, chat with quirky festival-goers, and just enjoy the wholesome vibes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/54d2da91b249b1813c658a9c2ff6ada5fc60aacb.jpg[/img]

But the fun doesn’t stop at the festival - once you’ve earned some coins, you’ll start building and decorating your own little village. From cozy decorations to silly animals and relaxing surprises, you’ll make it your own little slice of feline paradise. 🏡✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45563817/dac551df20092b4c3809c1108c586162711aebe1.jpg[/img]

We’ll be sharing more updates as we get closer to launch—including platform-specific upgrades and a few extra surprises - [b]like, hmm, a demo version[/b] 👀 Until then, keep your paws ready and your lucky coins polished!

See you soon!
